scientific_integrity: Analytical argument covers all finite horizons and all dimensions within assumptions; a finite standard-library checker is supplementary. Bibliographic coverage is qualified, independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional self-adjoint contraction semigroups with distinct positive decay rates; one normalized real orbit vector and Lebesgue time window. Full finite-window classification, not a claim to new infinite-horizon optimization or earlier two-term small-time laws. A possible older equivalent total-positivity formulation remains a priority risk.
title: Exact finite-window lower frame bounds for diagonal contraction semigroups
